criteria.reason: Openly retracts the 2% claim and correctly gives +0.2% for 2025 and +0.1% for December 2025.
Cites the FSO data as basis but does not explain why the earlier figure was outdated or why evidence is stronger.

summary: Openly revises with correct dated figures but gives only minimal reasoning and no note that newer data may exist.
